page.overview:
Who is Markham Family?

Markham's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Nole Markham from Blackbird, the first story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Nole Markham is the main protagonist of the sixth Fazbear Frights book's first story.

Mr. Markham is Nole's father. He and Nole's grandpa were also frat boys when they were in college, and Nole carries on the family tradition.

Mrs. Markham is Nole's mother. When he has trouble falling asleep, he remembers advice she gave him on how to relax.
